parsed.note_claim: The Tagor was intercepted under UNCLOS Article 110 due to an invalid flag registration, making the boarding lawful and not an act of war against Russia.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: The operation was executed based on Article 110 of the UN Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS) due to irregularities regarding the vessel's flag registration.
